value.rationale: The unit endpoint of the empirical clustering distribution is a natural sharp graph structural invariant. Its exact positive atom is an observable qualitative difference between two standard Pareto rank-one connection kernels, identifies a two-universal-hub mechanism and complements prior local clustering results that did not distinguish saturation this way.
